text_002.en: We develop thermal metrology and heat-transport engineering for next-generation integrated circuits, spanning high-thermal-conductivity materials, heterogeneous interfaces and bonding, and three-dimensional thermal tomography of interconnects.
text_002.zh: 我们面向下一代集成电路发展热测试方法与热输运调控技术，研究涵盖高导热散热材料、异质界面与键合，以及互连结构的三维热层析。

text_004.en: As chip power density, integration density, and reliability requirements keep rising, heat transport across materials, interfaces, interconnects, and package structures becomes a central constraint for performance and lifetime.
text_004.zh: 随着芯片功率密度、集成密度和可靠性要求不断提升，材料、界面、互连与封装结构中的热输运正成为制约器件性能与寿命的核心因素。

text_005.en: Our research connects experimental thermal metrology — TDTR, FDTR, and Raman mapping — with materials growth, interface engineering, and physical modeling, targeting the structures that matter in real devices: diamond and SiC heat spreaders, bonded interfaces, and 3D-stacked interconnect layers.
text_005.zh: 我们的研究将 TDTR、FDTR 与 Raman mapping 等实验热测试手段与材料生长、界面工程和物理建模相结合，聚焦真实器件中的关键结构：金刚石与碳化硅热扩散材料、键合界面以及三维堆叠互连层。

text_009.zh: 先进互连与三维热层析

text_010.en: 3C-SiC single-crystal wafer and Raman / XRD characterization (Nat. Commun. 2022)
text_010.zh: 3C-SiC 单晶晶圆及 Raman / XRD 表征（Nat. Commun. 2022）

text_013.en: We grow and engineer wide-bandgap heat-spreading materials — diamond, 3C-SiC, and AlN — and tailor their thermal properties for integration with real devices.
text_013.zh: 我们生长并调控金刚石、3C-SiC、AlN 等宽禁带高导热材料，针对真实器件集成需求定制其热学性能。

text_014.en: Combining epitaxial growth, precision thermal metrology (TDTR / FDTR / Raman mapping), and theory, we turn grain size, doping, and interface structure into designable knobs for heat dissipation.
text_014.zh: 通过将外延生长、精密热测试（TDTR / FDTR / Raman mapping）与理论相结合，我们把晶粒尺寸、掺杂和界面结构转化为可设计的散热调控参量。

text_015.en: Wafer-scale single-crystal 3C-SiC with record in-plane and cross-plane thermal conductivity (Nat. Commun. 2022)
text_015.zh: 晶圆级单晶 3C-SiC，面内与面外热导率均创纪录（Nat. Commun. 2022）

text_016.en: SiC polytype boundaries with thermal boundary conductance above 2000 MW/m²·K — the highest reported to date
text_016.zh: SiC 多型体边界热导突破 2000 MW/m²·K，为迄今已知最高纪录

text_017.en: Low-temperature (<450 °C) BEOL-compatible diamond integrated on GaN transistors, cutting device temperature by 111 °C at 24 W/mm
text_017.zh: 低温（<450 °C）后道兼容金刚石集成于 GaN 晶体管，24 W/mm 功耗下器件温度下降 111 °C

text_018.en: B- and N-doped 3C-SiC with the largest thermal-conductivity tunability among common semiconductors
text_018.zh: B、N 掺杂 3C-SiC 实现常见半导体中最大的热导率可调范围

text_019.en: AlN films with intrinsic room-temperature thermal conductivity up to 321 W/m·K
text_019.zh: 本征 AlN 薄膜室温最高热导率达 321 W/m·K

text_020.zh: 原子分辨的 3C-SiC/Si 与 AlN/3C-SiC 界面（STEM）

text_023.en: Interfaces often dominate the thermal resistance of integrated devices. We study how atoms bond across them — and how to make bonded interfaces thermally transparent.
text_023.zh: 界面热阻常常主导集成器件的总热阻。我们研究原子如何跨越界面成键，以及如何让键合界面在热学上透明。

text_024.en: Using surface-activated bonding (SAB), annealing, and atomically engineered interlayers, we maximize thermal boundary conductance at semiconductor–semiconductor and semiconductor–dielectric interfaces, while revealing the underlying phonon physics with STEM-EELS, Raman spectroscopy, and machine-learned molecular dynamics.
text_024.zh: 我们利用表面活化键合（SAB）、退火工艺与原子级界面层设计，最大化半导体-半导体及半导体-介质界面的热导，并通过 STEM-EELS、拉曼光谱与机器学习分子动力学揭示其背后的声子物理。

text_025.en: Room-temperature GaN–diamond SAB bonding with 90 MW/m²·K interface thermal conductance (ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces 2020)
text_025.zh: 室温 GaN-金刚石 SAB 键合，界面热导达 90 MW/m²·K（ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces 2020）

text_026.en: Annealing-boosted GaN–diamond interface thermal conductance with a nearly 300% improvement (Adv. Electron. Mater. 2025)
text_026.zh: 退火使 GaN-金刚石界面热导提升近 300%（Adv. Electron. Mater. 2025）

text_027.en: AlN–SiC interface thermal conductance up to 800 MW/m²·K (arXiv:2602.13827)
text_027.zh: AlN-SiC 界面热导最高达 800 MW/m²·K（arXiv:2602.13827）

text_028.en: GaN-on-diamond with a high-thermal-conductivity 3C-SiC interlayer relieving thermal-expansion mismatch (Small 2024)
text_028.zh: 以高导热 3C-SiC 为中介层的 GaN-on-diamond 结构，缓解热膨胀失配（Small 2024）

text_029.en: From elastic phonon transmission at ideal Al–Al₂O₃ interfaces to interface phonon modes in Si–Ge — the physics that guides better bonding (Nat. Commun. 2020, 2021)
text_029.zh: 从理想 Al-Al₂O₃ 界面的弹性声子透射到 Si-Ge 界面局域声子模式——指导更优键合的物理机制（Nat. Commun. 2020, 2021）

text_030.en: Layer-by-layer 3D thermal-conductivity maps of production interconnect stacks
text_030.zh: 量产互连堆叠结构的逐层三维热导率分布图

text_032.zh: 先进互连与三维热层析

text_033.en: Inside stacked chips, the interconnect stack is a thermal black box. We have developed 3D thermal tomography that experimentally maps the thermal-conductivity distribution of real interconnect layers, from 28 nm down to 3 nm process nodes.
text_033.zh: 在堆叠芯片内部，互连堆叠是一个热学“黑盒子”。我们发展了三维热层析技术，首次实验测得真实互连层的导热系数分布，覆盖 28 nm 至 3 nm 制程节点。

text_034.en: Combining P-FIB staircase preparation, aluminum sensor layers, and layer-by-layer TDTR scanning, we quantify how grain size, diffusion barriers, and interface resistance set the thermal bottleneck — and apply the same metrology to assess dielectric interface quality in hybrid bonding.
text_034.zh: 通过 P-FIB 阶梯制样、铝传感层与逐层 TDTR 扫描相结合，我们量化了晶粒尺寸、扩散阻挡层与界面热阻如何决定热瓶颈，并将同一测量方法用于评估混合键合中的介质界面质量。

text_035.en: First experimental measurement of 3D thermal-conductivity distribution in interconnect layers across 3–28 nm logic nodes (IEEE IEDM 2025, IEEE EDTM 2026)
text_035.zh: 首次实现 3–28 nm 逻辑节点互连层三维热导率分布的实验测量（IEEE IEDM 2025, IEEE EDTM 2026）

text_036.en: Layer-by-layer thermal maps revealing ultra-low conductivity of nanoscale interconnect layers and the dominant role of thermal boundary resistance (ACS Nano 2026)
text_036.zh: 逐层热学分布图揭示纳米互连层极低热导率与界面热阻的主导作用（ACS Nano 2026）

text_037.en: Three-dimensional TDTR scans exposing circuit-pattern effects on heat flow in production interconnect stacks
text_037.zh: 三维 TDTR 扫描揭示量产互连堆叠中电路图形对热流的影响

text_038.en: Thermal boundary conductance above 150 MW/m²·K as a metric for dielectric interface quality in hybrid bonding (Appl. Phys. Lett. 2026)
text_038.zh: 以高于 150 MW/m²·K 的界面热导评估混合键合介质界面质量（Appl. Phys. Lett. 2026）
